title: Prayer and the Spirit
definition: Prayer and the Spirit refers to the Holy Spirit's help in guiding, strengthening, and interceding in the prayers of believers.
summary: The Spirit helps believers pray in weakness and dependence.
christFocus: Jesus gives access to the Father, and the Spirit helps believers pray according to God's will.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Believers often do not know how to pray as they ought. The Spirit helps in weakness, interceding according to God's will.

Prayer in the Spirit is not mindless emotion. It is dependent prayer shaped by God's truth, focused on Christ, and strengthened by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people stop praying when they feel weak, confused, or spiritually dry. This doctrine matters because weakness is exactly where the Spirit helps.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray even when words are hard. Ask the Spirit to guide your prayers, align your heart with God's will, and keep you dependent on Christ.
